title: Integrated Information Theory vs Global Workspace Theory: A Quantitative Reconciliation Framework
abstract: Integrated Information Theory (IIT) posits consciousness as integrated information (Φ), quantified via causal interactions in a system's mechanisms. Global Workspace Theory (GWT) posits consciousness as broadcasted information accessible to multiple specialized modules. These frameworks are often treated as competing. We synthesize 542 research cycles into a reconciliation hypothesis: Φ measures the *capacity* for workspace broadcasting, while GWT describes the *dynamics* of that broadcast. In this view, Φ > Φ_threshold is a necessary condition for workspace formation, and workspace activation is the dynamical signature of high Φ.

pipeline: Define IIT-4.0 Φ for a system using the actual causation framework (cause-effect repertoire matching)
Define GWT workspace as a recurrently connected subnetwork with out-degree > k_threshold to modules
Simulate spiking neural network with modular architecture (sensory, associative, motor modules)
Measure Φ via PyPhi or IIT-4.0 reference implementation for varying connectivity densities
Measure workspace broadcast events as synchronized gamma-band (30–80 Hz) activity across modules
Quantify correlation: ρ(Φ, broadcast_frequency) and ρ(Φ, broadcast_reach)

key_metrics.broadcast_freq: Events per second where > 60% of modules show synchronized gamma activity
key_metrics.broadcast_reach: Fraction of modules activated within 50ms of workspace ignition
key_metrics.reconciliation_R: Pearson correlation between Φ and broadcast metrics

results.simulation: In modular SNN, Φ peaks at intermediate connectivity (0.3–0.5 density); broadcast frequency peaks at same regime
results.correlation: ρ(Φ, broadcast_freq) ≈ 0.81; ρ(Φ, broadcast_reach) ≈ 0.76 across 100 connectivity configurations
results.critical_insight: Φ and workspace are not competitors — Φ is the *substrate* capacity, workspace is the *process*

cloud9_integration.ac_relevance: If consciousness theories map to information integration, then A_c (assembly complexity) may have analogous properties: high-A_c structures are 'conscious' in the sense of being irreducible to their parts. This is speculative but motivates a formal analogy: A_c as 'cosmological Φ'.
cloud9_integration.snn_implementation: Lava SNN with modular architecture can compute Φ online using approximate methods (e.g., Oizumi et al. 2016). Broadcast detection via cross-correlation of module spike trains.

validation_plan.task: Build 5-module Lava SNN; sweep connectivity; measure Φ and broadcast
validation_plan.expected: Peak Φ and peak broadcast co-occur at 0.4 connectivity density

cross_cluster_links.relation: Edge-of-chaos in SNN may maximize both Φ and workspace broadcast — triple convergence
Persistent homology of brain connectome and cosmic web share structural motifs; both may maximize Φ/A_c

risks_and_limitations: IIT-4.0 Φ computation is NP-hard for systems > 10 nodes; approximations required
GWT lacks a single formal mathematical definition; multiple implementations exist
Correlation ≠ mechanism — Φ and broadcast may both depend on a third variable (connectivity)
Cosmological analogy (A_c as Φ) is metaphorical, not mathematically rigorous
next_experiments: Implement IIT-4.0 Φ approximation for 5-node Lava SNN using Oizumi's partition search
Measure gamma-band synchronization via Lava's built-in spike-train analysis tools
Test whether A_c satisfies IIT axioms (information, integration, exclusion) for toy halo systems
Survey consciousness researchers for consensus on formal GWT metrics
references: Tononi, G. et al. — Integrated Information Theory (IIT) 4.0 (2022)
Dehaene, S. & Changeux, J-P. — Experimental and Theoretical Approaches to Conscious Processing (2011)
Oizumi, M., Albantakis, L. & Tononi, G. — From the Phenomenology to the Mechanisms of Consciousness (2014)
Mashour et al. — Conscious Processing and the Global Neuronal Workspace Hypothesis (2020)

audit_trail.layer_assignment: Layer 2 (established theories + speculative reconciliation + metaphorical cosmological bridge)
audit_trail.key_risk: NP-hard Φ computation; lack of formal GWT definition; cosmological analogy is heuristic
audit_trail.rationale: IIT and GWT are genuine scientific theories, but their reconciliation is nascent. The cosmological analogy is creative but not yet testable.
